before.name: Reduction in landfill-bound waste vs 2005
before.source: NYC Department of Sanitation (DSNY) Monthly Tonnage Data, NYC Open Data dataset ebb7-mvp5 — refusetonscollected aggregated citywide via Socrata SoQL sum, FY2005 vs FY2025

scoring.worked_math: NYC Open Data 'DSNY Monthly Tonnage Data' (dataset ebb7-mvp5), field refusetonscollected, summed across all 59 community districts for two full fiscal years (708 district-month records each, confirming complete coverage: 59 districts × 12 months = 708). FY2005 (Jul 2004–Jun 2005) total refuse tons collected = 3,348,817.81. FY2025 (Jul 2024–Jun 2025, most recent complete fiscal year as of Aug 2026) total refuse tons collected = 2,928,470.67. % reduction = (3,348,817.81 − 2,928,470.67) / 3,348,817.81 × 100 = 420,347.14 / 3,348,817.81 × 100 = 12.55%. level_pct (higher_is_better) = (target − value) / scale × 100 = (90 − 12.55) / 90 × 100 = 86.06.
